output.summary: KEP-671 proposes building support for the out-of-tree IBM cloud provider, centered on a well-tested IBM cloud-controller-manager with feature parity to kube-controller-manager. The KEP is currently in provisional status.
output.rationale: The KEP addresses moving IBM Cloud clusters from in-tree cloud provider code to an out-of-tree cloud-controller-manager, motivated by the general Cloud Controller Manager KEP. Its goals are to develop, test, and release the IBM cloud-controller-manager and to have IBM clusters run it. Removal of the in-tree IBM code is explicitly out of scope and handled by the separate in-tree removal KEP. The status is provisional, and the excerpt gives no further rationale or outcome.

alternatives.option: Removing the in-tree IBM cloud provider code as part of this KEP
alternatives.why_not: Stated as a non-goal: removing in-tree IBM code falls under the KEP for removing in-tree providers.

evidence.quote: Build support for the out-of-tree IBM cloud provider. This involves a well-tested version of the cloud-controller-manager that has feature parity to the kube-controller-manager.
Motivation for supporting out-of-tree providers can be found in the [Cloud Controller Manager KEP]
Removing in-tree IBM cloud provider code, this effort falls under the [KEP for removing in-tree providers]
